entries.name: Authorization
entries.syn: GAM requires authorization to perform tasks on your domain; the tasks break down into two categories:

entries.name: gam create gcpfolder
tags: Create a new GCP project folder

entries.name: gam create gcpfolder

entries.name: gam create project
ex:
gam create project [admin <EmailAddress>] [project <ProjectID>]
        [appname <String>] [supportemail <EmailAddress>]
        [projectname <ProjectName>] [parent <String>]
        [saname <ServiceAccountName>] [sadisplayname <ServiceAccountDisplayName>]
        [sadescription <ServiceAccountDescription>]
        [(algorithm KEY_ALG_RSA_1024|KEY_ALG_RSA_2048)|
         (localkeysize 1024|2048|4096 [validityhours <Number>])|
         (yubikey yubikey_pin yubikey_slot AUTHENTICATION|SIGNATURE yubikey_serialnumber <Number>)|
  …

entries.name: Bulk Processing
entries.syn: Batch and CSV file processing can improve performance by executing Gam commands in parallel.

entries.name: gam csv NewStudents.csv gam create user
entries.syn: gam csv NewStudents.csv gam create user "~Email" firstname "~First" lastname "~Last" org "/Students/~~GradYear~~" password "~Password"
ex:
gam csv NewStudents.csv gam create user "~Email" firstname "~First" lastname "~Last" org "/Students/~~GradYear~~" password "~Password"
commit-batch
gam update group seniors sync members ou /Students/2020
gam update group juniors sync members ou /Students/2021
gam update group sophomores sync members ou /Students/2022
gam update group highschool sync members ous "'/Students/2020','/Students/2021','/Students/2022'"

entries.name: gam csv Users.csv gam update user
entries.syn: gam csv Users.csv gam update user "~primaryEmail" address type work unstructured "~~Street~~, ~~City~~, ~~State~~ ~~ZIP~~" primary note text_plain "~~primaryEmail~!~^(.+)@(.+)$~!~\1 AT \2~~"
ex: gam csv Users.csv gam update user "~primaryEmail" address type work unstructured "~~Street~~, ~~City~~, ~~State~~ ~~ZIP~~" primary note text_plain "~~primaryEmail~!~^(.+)@(.+)$~!~\1 AT \2~~"

ex: gam csv gsheet <user> <fileID> "<sheetName>" gam update user "~primaryEmail" address type work unstructured "~~Street~~, ~~City~~, ~~State~~ ~~ZIP~~" primary note text_plain "~~primaryEmail~!~^(.+)@(.+)$~!~\1 AT \2~~"

entries.syn: gam redirect csv ./filelistperms.csv multiprocess csv Users.csv gam user "~primaryEmail" print filelist fields id,name,mimetype,basicpermissions

ex: gam redirect csv ./filelistperms.csv multiprocess csv Users.csv gam user "~primaryEmail" print filelist fields id,name,mimetype,basicpermissions
gam redirect csv - multiprocess todrive csv Users.csv gam user "~primaryEmail" print filelist fields id,name,mimetype,basicpermissions

entries.name: CSV Input Filtering
entries.syn: There are two values in gam.cfg that can be used to filter the input from gam csv commands.

entries.name: gam redirect csv
entries.syn: gam redirect csv GroupInfo.csv print groups fields directmemberscount
entries.desc: You want to process groups not created by an administrator.
ex: gam redirect csv GroupInfo.csv print groups fields directmemberscount
gam config csv_input_row_filter "'directMembersCount:count>100'" csv GroupInfo.csv gam group "~email" ...
gam redirect csv GroupInfo.csv print groups fields admincreated
gam config csv_input_row_drop_filter "'adminCreated:boolean:true'" csv GroupInfo.csv gam group "~email" ...
gam redirect csv UserInfo.csv print users fields creationtime

entries.name: gam redirect csv
entries.syn: gam redirect csv UserInfo.csv report user services accounts fields "accounts:used_quota_in_mb"
ex: gam redirect csv UserInfo.csv report user services accounts fields "accounts:used_quota_in_mb"
gam config csv_input_row_filter "'\"accounts:used_quota_in_mb\":count>15000'" csv_input_row_limit 10 csv UserInfo.csv gam user "~primaryEmail" ...

entries.name: gam redirect csv
entries.syn: gam redirect csv UserInfo.csv print users fields name,phones
ex: gam redirect csv UserInfo.csv print users fields name,phones
gam selectinputfilter Filter510 csv UserInfo.csv gam user "~primaryEmail" ...

entries.name: CSV Output Filtering
entries.syn: There are seven values in gam.cfg that can be used to filter the output from gam print commands.

entries.name: gam print users name
entries.desc: With inclusion filtering.
ex:
gam print users name
primaryEmail,name.givenName,name.familyName,name.fullName
testuser1@domain.com,Test,User1,Test User1
testuser2@domain.com,Test,User2,Test User2
...

entries.name: gam config csv_output_header_filter "primaryEmail,name.fullName" print users
entries.syn: gam config csv_output_header_filter "primaryEmail,name.fullName" print users name
entries.desc: With exclusion filtering.
ex:
gam config csv_output_header_filter "primaryEmail,name.fullName" print users name
primaryEmail,name.fullName
testuser1@domain.com,Test User1
testuser2@domain.com,Test User2
...

entries.name: gam config csv_output_header_drop_filter "name.givenName,name.familyName" print users

testuser2@domain.com,Test User2
...

entries.name: gam config csv_output_row_filter
entries.desc: You optionally specify whether all or any value filters must match for the row to be included in the output.

entries.name: gam config csv_output_row_drop_filter
entries.desc: You optionally specify whether all or any value filters must match for the row to be excluded from the output.

entries.name: gam config csv_output_row_filter
entries.syn: gam config csv_output_row_filter "'directMembersCount:count>100'" print groups fields directmemberscount
entries.desc: You want a list of users created in the last 30 days.
ex: gam config csv_output_row_filter "'directMembersCount:count>100'" print groups fields directmemberscount
gam config csv_output_row_filter "'creationTime:date>=-30d'" print users fields creationtime
gam config csv_output_row_filter "'\"accounts:used_quota_in_mb\":count>15000'" report users select ou /Test fields accounts:used_quota_in_mb
gam config csv_output_row_filter "'orgUnitPath:regex:^/Test$'" print users query "orgUnitPath=/Test" fields name,ou
gam config csv_output_row_filter "'orgUnitPath:regex:^/Test$','gender:regex:female'" print users query "orgUnitPath=/Test" fields name,ou,gender

entries.name: Tag Replace
entries.syn: Several commands use template files for messages and signatures; Gam has the ability to replace tags in the template with data from the command line or from user attributes.

entries.name: gam <UserTypeEntity> signature file SigTemplate.txt html
entries.desc: When adding a phone number to a signature, an unformatted number can be formatted:
alias: gam user signature file SigTemplate.txt html
ex:
gam <UserTypeEntity> signature file SigTemplate.txt html
        replace first field:name.givenname replace last field:name.familyname
        replace officephone field:phone.value.type.work replace mobilephone field:phone.value.type.work
        replace mobilephone field:phone.value.type.work replace mobilephone field:phone.value.type.mobile
        replace email field:email.primaryemail
        replace address field:address.formatted
        replace department field:organization.department replace title field:organization.title
        replace building field:location.buildingname replace floor field:location.floorname

entries.name: Todrive
entries.syn: Gam print commands allow the results to be uploaded to Google Drive instead of being saved locally.

entries.name: gam print users fields
entries.syn: gam print users fields id,name todrive tdtitle "User IDs and Names" tdtimestamp true tduser usermgr@domain.com tdparent "GAM Reports"
entries.desc: Generate a list of CrOS devices and update an existing sheet in a Google spreadsheet. The sheet ID is preserved so other appplications can access the data using the file ID and sheet ID.
ex: gam print users fields id,name todrive tdtitle "User IDs and Names" tdtimestamp true tduser usermgr@domain.com tdparent "GAM Reports"

gam redirect csv - todrive tdtitle "CrOS" tdtimestamp true tdfileid 12345-mizZ6Q2vP1rcHQH3tAZQt_NVB2EOxmS2SU3yM tdsheet id:0 tdupdatesheet true print cros fields deviceId,notes,orgUnitPath,serialNumber,osversion
gam redirect csv - multiprocess todrive tdtitle AnyoneShares-All csv Users.csv gam user "~primaryEmail" print filelist fields id,name,permissions pm type anyone em
gam csv Users.csv gam redirect csv - todrive tdtitle "AnyoneShares-~~primaryEmail~~" user "~primaryEmail" print filelist fields id,name,permissions pm type anyone em
gam csv Users.csv gam user "~primaryEmail" print filelist fields id,name,permissions pm type anyone em todrive tdtitle "AnyoneShares-~~primaryEmail~~"

entries.name: gam redirect csv - todrive tdfileid
entries.syn: gam redirect csv - todrive tdfileid <DriveFileID> tdupdatesheet tdsheet Tuesday tdbackupsheet "Backup Tuesday" tdcopysheet "Latest" ...
